newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE GRAINS FALL ON STG RECOVERY, CROP PROGRESS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE GRAINS FALL ON STG RECOVERY, CROP PROGRESS.

text.p: LIFFE grains fell on sterling's recovery to above 2.95 marks and some merchant hedge selling after farmers made good progress with the wheat harvest over the weekend, traders said.
Active November wheat last traded 0.90 stg lower at 87.10 stg, on volume of 206 of a total 438 lots.
On barley, November was also the most active, with 62 lots done of the total 158. It last traded 0.85 stg lower at 81.25 stg.
Farmers in southern England moved fast to harvest wheat in hot sunny weather over the weekend, farming sources said.
Sterling dipped below 2.95 marks in afternoon European trading, down from an earlier session high above 2.96 but up from late Friday's 2.9272/77 marks.
